thread:
mia_sales: ACME Financial asked for a single-line POC quote covering API + Optimize credits + Console admin seats, 12mo term, and a clause for usage spikes. Need an approved structure.

 tom_account_exec: Quick facts: projected starting ARR ~$1.08M (API heavy). Asking for 25% off blended. Will accept longer prepay if needed.

 jane_salesops: Reminder: discounts <=15% auto; 15-25% require finance sign-off; >25% route to CRO+legal. We must provide a line-item appendix even if we give a single net ARR number to the buyer.

 eli_engineering: Tech items to call out: Dedicated reserve if they want low latency (+$10k/mo estimated), private control plane setup one-time ~$30k, Console audit log retention is configurable (1yr default). Optimize usage can be sold as a credit bucket that expires with term.

 mia_sales: Can we structure like: API commit discount ~14%, Optimize ~30% when bundled, Console seats ~20% off for 12mo commit, then show blended net?

 jane_salesops: That structure is workable. Draft commercial snippet (internal):
 - API committed ARR: $900,000/yr (list $1,050,000) -> 14.3% commit discount
 - Optimize credit pool: $120,000/yr (list $170,000) -> 29.4% bundle discount
 - Console (12 seats): $43,200/yr (list $54,000) -> 20% off
 - One-time setup (private control plane): $30,000 (if requested)
 - Effective net ARR: $1,063,200/yr -> ~19.5% blended vs list
 - Conditions: 12mo prepay preferred; credits expire at term end; true-up clause if usage >150% in a quarter.

 tom_account_exec: Finance willing to approve ~20% blended if prepay and SOW limits free trial compute. I'll open a deal desk ticket.

 dealdesk_bot: Deal desk ticket created: DD-2026-99. Approvers: salesops, finance, legal. Please attach pricing worksheet and draft SOW.

 jane_salesops: Uploaded worksheet and SOW to DD-2026-99. Legal please review payment terms and the renegotiation clause for usage growth. Security please note SOC2 + infra diagram required for questionnaire.

 mia_sales: Perfect. I'll hold the one-line net ARR for exec summary until DD approval. If approved, I'll send to buyer with appendix and POC SOW. Thanks all :pray:
